Class FilehandlerExchange

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.filehandler.FilehandlerExchange
public class FilehandlerExchange extends Object
Responsible for handling file input and output operations related to Exchange and Stock objects.

This class provides functionality for: Saving exchange data to CSV files Loading initial exchange data from CSV Loading previously saved exchange data

All methods are static and the class is not intended to be instantiated.

  • Method Details

    • saveExchangeData

      public static boolean saveExchangeData(Exchange exchange, String folderPath)
      Saves the current state of an Exchange to a CSV file in a designated save folder. Usually invoke on SaveManager

      The file will be stored in a folder in resources/saves/ directory. File includes exchange name, difficulty during playtime and current week (as comments) All stocks with their symbol, company name, and price history AND Extras stock attributes if the strategy implemented

      Uses comma as the separator

      Parameters:
      exchange - the Exchange object to be saved
      folderPath - THE FULL PATH, provided by SaveManager
      Returns:
      the filename (without path) of the saved file

    • getExchangeDataset

      public static Exchange getExchangeDataset(String filename)
      Loads initial exchange data from a predefined

      The file is expected to be located at: resources/Exchanges/exchangeDataSet1.csv

      Each valid line in the file should contain: Ticker,CompanyName,InitialPrice (As demonstrated at del 2 in Mappe)

      Lines starting with '#' and empty lines are ignored.

      Parameters:
      filename - filename to a csv file in resources/datasets
      Returns:
      a new Exchange object populated with stocks from the file

    • getExchangeSaveData

      public static Exchange getExchangeSaveData(String folderPath)
      Loads a previously saved exchange state from a CSV file in a designated folder Usually invoke on SaveManager

      First row contains the Metadata: Name,week,difficulty,Strategy THIS ONLY APPLIES TO SAVES, not regular/imported exchange data

      Each data (expect the first) row must follow the format: Ticker,CompanyName,price1;price2;price3;... Strategies might implement extra stock data, for example MarketSimulator. Extras will then be inserted into a fourth row. Ticker,CompanyName,price1;price2;price3,0|21|9|0

      The first price is used as the initial price when creating the Stock, and the remaining prices are added to reconstruct the full price history.

      Lines starting with '#' and empty lines are ignored.

      Parameters:
      folderPath - THE FULL PATH, provided by SaveManager
      Returns:
      a reconstructed Exchange object based on the saved data

    • importExternalData

      public static Boolean importExternalData()
      Method to import your own Exchange Data in a valid csv format that resembles ours.

      Should be able to access the systems file explorer, search for a csv file, add it and be sent into the resources/datasets folder. This method cannot be Unit tested as it incorporates GUI dialogs which cannot be tested.

      Returns:
      true/false based on if it worked or not.

    • validFormat

      public static boolean validFormat(Path filePath)
      Helper function for importExternalData() method that checks if attempted import is off valid format.

      Valid format should be

      • At least 5 rows of data
      • Each row of data is separated by comma and are of three columns
      • Third column is parsable to BigDecimal
      Parameters:
      filePath - The file path to the dataset
      Returns:
      true/false based on if the selected is valid format or not
